title: A Certain Magical Index
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Manga adaptation of the light novels. In Academy City, a science-driven city of students with psychic 'esper' powers, unlucky high schooler Touma Kamijo has a right hand that cancels any supernatural power. He takes in Index, a young nun from a secret magic branch of the Church of England whose memory holds 103,000 forbidden grimoires, and is drawn into conflicts between sorcerers and the scientific esper establishment.
life_message: Standing up for others with whatever ordinary strength you have matters more than rank or power.
